$comment: The canvas: a page of charts a visitor builds by putting fields into each chart's zones (work order 2 section 5, D-138, D-147). Each chart is a Build question (config/presets.json, builder), so this file holds no measure, dataset or rule of its own: it holds the canvas's interface words, which fields sit in which group of the field list, a shorter one-line definition for the few fields that need one, and the names of the chart types. Read by src/lib/canvas.ts (what a field may do in a zone, which chart types fit, the address) and src/lib/canvasFields.ts (the field list). Every text under words, chart_types, measures, groups, kinds, measure_kinds and the time field's label is a template the lint holds to config/narrative/rules.json (pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py): no digit, no causal or judgement word, no value or label of a reference file; a name comes in as a placeholder. definitions and the time field's definition are not templates: like the data map's, a definition says what a field holds and may name what it holds.
$max_charts_comment: How many charts one canvas holds. A link that names more keeps the first ones.

time_field.$comment: The month of first registration is the horizontal axis of every chart over time and is set through the period, so it is not a dimension in config/dimensions.json. It is listed among the fields so a visitor can find it, and it can be put in the Period zone and nowhere else. map_fields names the two register fields it is read from, the year and the month of the year, as config/data_map.json has them.
time_field.label: Month of first registration
time_field.definition: The month the vehicle was first registered in New Zealand. Every chart over time runs along it; the period sets how much of it is drawn.

$groups_comment: The field list's groups, in order. A field goes to the first group that lists the data map group of the register field it is made from (config/data_map.json, group) and, where the group names kinds, whose kinds include the field's own. A field made from a reference file about that register field, and not from the field itself, can be placed by hand in group_of. tests/site/canvas.test.ts holds every field the canvas lists to exactly one group and to a definition of one line.

definitions.$comment: A field's one-line definition, shown when a visitor hovers over, focuses or taps it, is its dimension's own help line (config/dimensions.json, help), so it is written once. This block holds a line for the few fields whose help line is longer than a line of the list or is written for a maintainer. Each is that help line shortened: none says anything it does not.
definitions.make: The badge on the car, matched to a list of brands.
definitions.model: The nameplate, as brand and model. The models with the most vehicles in the last 12 months keep their name; the rest are grouped together.
definitions.vehicle_usage: How NZTA records the vehicle as used now, in a few broad groups. Counted over the vehicles registered today, never by when a vehicle was first registered.
definitions.vehicle_year_band: Years since the vehicle year: for a vehicle sold new here from 2007, since first registration; for a used import, since the vehicle's year overseas.
definitions.nzta_class: NZTA's vehicle equipment standard class: NZTA's label with the code in brackets.

measures.$comment: How the Measure zone names each measure the builder offers as one chart (config/presets.json, builder.measures). A measure drawn as two charts is not offered on a canvas: a visitor adds a chart for each.

measure_kinds.$comment: A kind of measure (config/measures.json, kind) as a chart type's reason names it.

kinds.$comment: A kind of field (config/dimensions.json, kind) as a reason names it, and as the field list says it beside a field's name.

chart_types.label: Shares over time
chart_types.help: Each value's share, month by month.

chart_types.label: Grid
chart_types.help: Two fields crossed for one window.

$chart_types_comment: The six shapes (config/chart_rules.json), in the order the picker lists those that do not fit. Which fit a question is the rule table's to say, never this file's. table is the seventh choice: the figures of the chart as a table, always available (CLAUDE.md, Shapes).

table.label: Table
table.help: The figures behind the chart, as a table.

words.$comment: Interface words and the reasons the canvas gives. Placeholders: {field} and {other} are field names; {dataset} a dataset's public name; {measure} a measure's name as the Measure zone says it; {zone} a zone's name; {type} a chart type's name; {wanted} what a chart type needs, as the names of measures or in words from kinds or measure_kinds; {number} and {months} whole numbers; {top_n} how many values a measure gathers; {date} the snapshot's date or the day a canvas was saved; {name} the name of a saved canvas, or a chart's title; {query} what a visitor typed; {reason} another template, filled; {shown} what a chart shows in place of what a link asked for. config/narrative/rules.json lists them for the lint.
words.starters_intro: Each one opens as a canvas of ready-made charts. Change any chart, add more, and the address keeps your page.
words.starter_empty_help: It begins with one chart. Choose what it counts and how to break it down.
words.starters_none: No ready-made canvas can be drawn from this snapshot's data. Start an empty canvas to ask your own question.
words.page_lead: Build your own page of charts. Drag a field onto a zone of a chart, or choose a field and say where it goes, and the chart redraws.
words.not_available: No chart can be built from this snapshot's data.
words.canvas_full: A canvas holds up to {number} charts. Remove one to add another.
words.cannot_move_earlier: This chart is the first on the canvas.
words.cannot_move_later: This chart is the last on the canvas.
words.move_here: Drop to put the chart here
words.width_help: Two charts of half width share a row where the screen is wide enough.
words.status_chart_duplicated: Chart {number} is a copy of the chart before it.
words.gap_measure: This link asked to measure “{query}”, which {dataset} does not have. This chart shows “{measure}” instead. To change it, choose another in {zone}.
words.gap_type_unknown: This link asked for the chart type “{query}”, which the canvas does not draw. This chart shows its best fit, “{shown}”. To change it, choose a chart type.
words.gap_type_unfit: This link asked for the chart type “{type}”, which does not fit this question, so this chart shows “{shown}”. {reason}
words.link_preset_dropped: This link named a ready-made question that does not match this chart, so the chart is titled by what it shows.
words.pin_reading: Checking which snapshot this chart is pinned to…
words.pin_unavailable: A pin is not offered for this canvas: the figures of its charts end in an earlier month than the snapshot month.
words.saved_intro: Save this canvas to come back to it. A saved canvas opens on the newest month. Pin it to keep the window of each chart that can hold one.
words.saved_browser_only: Saved in this browser, and nowhere else. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the list does not follow you to another browser or device.
words.saved_copy_link: Copy the link to this canvas
words.saved_empty: Nothing saved yet. Save this canvas and it is listed here.
words.saved_unavailable: This browser is not letting the page keep a list, so canvases cannot be saved or listed here. The canvas works as usual. Copy its link to keep it.
words.saved_failed: The browser would not keep the list, so nothing was saved. Copy the link to this canvas to keep it.
words.saved_unreadable: Saved canvases that could not be read were left out of the list: {number}.
words.saved_carried: Questions you saved before were added to this list as canvases: {number}.
words.saved_too_long: This canvas is too long to save. Copy its link to keep it.
words.status_saved_full: The list holds up to {number} canvases. Remove one to save another.
words.status_link_not_copied: The link could not be copied. Copy it from the address bar.
words.status_list_not_copied: The list could not be copied. Select the text and copy it.
words.finding_values: Finding the largest to start from…
words.values_failed: The values to start from did not load. Reload the page to try again.
words.values_none: Nothing was counted in the last {months} months among the vehicles this chart keeps, so there is no largest to start from. Choose values of {field} to draw a line for each.
words.by_empty: All vehicles together. Put a field here to break them down.
words.by2_empty: Put a second field here to make a grid.
words.where_empty: Every vehicle is counted. Put a field here to filter.
words.values_page: The largest, chosen by the page
words.filter_cannot_apply: {dataset} cannot filter by {field}, so no chart is drawn. Remove the filter to see the chart.
words.field_about_hint: Point to a field, or tab to it, to read what it means.
words.no_field_matches: No field matches “{query}”. Try a shorter word, or clear the search to see every field.
words.picker_no_match: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a shorter word, or clear the search to see every value.
words.picker_no_match_filtered: Nothing matches “{query}” among the vehicles this chart's filters keep. Try a shorter word, or remove a filter.
words.picker_none_filtered: This chart's filters keep no vehicles, so there is nothing to choose from. Remove a filter to see values.
words.picker_none: There is nothing to choose from in this data.
words.status_period: The month of first registration is the period. Choose how much of it is drawn here.
words.refuse_not_for_measure: {measure} cannot be broken down by {field} in {dataset}.
words.refuse_filter_field: {dataset} does not break its figures down by {field}. It can filter a chart.
words.refuse_no_values: {dataset} cannot filter by {field}: its table holds the field on its own.
words.refuse_no_filters: {dataset} is published as small tables and takes no filters.
words.refuse_hidden_cells: {field} is published with small counts hidden, and this site does not draw a table like that yet.
words.refuse_not_offered: {field} is not offered as a breakdown or a filter yet.
words.refuse_nested: {field} and {other} nest, so a grid of the two would be empty off one line.
words.refuse_is_breakdown: {field} is in {zone}. Choose its values there.
words.refuse_time: Every chart over time runs along the month already. Set how much of it is drawn in {zone}.
words.refuse_period_field: {zone} takes the month of first registration, not {field}.
words.refuse_dataset_zone: {zone} takes one of the sets of figures in its list, not a field.
words.refuse_average_unpublished: No average of {field} is published yet. The figures hold counts, and each number is published in bands.
words.refuse_not_a_number: A measure is a number of vehicles, a share, or an average of a number. {field} is not a number: use it to break the chart down or to filter it.
words.average_reason: No average is published yet. The figures hold counts, and each number is published in bands.
words.why_second_field: {type} draws one field. Remove {field} from {zone} to use it.
words.why_one_period: {dataset} holds one period, so its figures are drawn as a ranking of one field or a grid of two.
words.why_measure: {type} shows {wanted}. Change the measure to use it.
words.why_by_kind: {type} needs {wanted} in {zone}, and {field} is not one.
words.why_picked: {type} needs two or more values of {field} chosen, or no values chosen.
words.why_values: {type} is for a field with a long list of values, and {field} has a short one.
words.why_blocked: {type} cannot be drawn from the published figures for this question.
